title: Funcdata constructor always binds an Architecture (glb = scope->getArch(), funcdata.cc:48)
status_note: Constructor-invariant observation. The C++ side boots the production x86-64 SLEIGH/BFD architecture (startDecompilerLibrary + BfdArchitecture(binary=default) + init + readLoaderSymbols, the same path as the callspec_identity fixture), constructs two Funcdata through the real constructor (funcdata.cc:34-82) and prints the wiring observables; the Rust mirror constructs two Funcdata via Funcdata::new, which binds the canonical default Architecture (OnceLock-shared Architecture::new(), the stand-in for scope->getArch() until the constructor grows a Scope parameter, FUNCDATA-LOCALSCOPE-OWNERSHIP-0001). Diffed projection (byte-identical stdout, empty stderr, rc=0 both sides): case=construct arch_nonnull=1; case=stack space_name=stack (ctor consumer funcdata.cc:54 glb->getStackSpace()); case=share arch_identity_shared=1 (single-database Architecture pointer sharing). C++-in-fixture assertion (not printable on the Rust side): fd.getArch() == scope->getArch() == &architecture and named-constructor ScopeLocal attached. Rust in-binary assertions (no C++ getter exists, private state): fd.min_laned_size == glb->getMinimumLanedRegisterSize() (funcdata.cc:49 wiring; raw value is spec-dependent: 16 on the booted x86-64 SLEIGH arch, -1 on the spec-less canonical default, so the raw value is deliberately excluded from the diffed projection), SplitDatatype gates on by default config (subflow.cc:2704-2707, architecture.cc:1430-1432 struct|array|pointer), set_arch override replaces the canonical binding and a caller-supplied config=0 turns both gates off (runner path).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Funcdata::Funcdata(nm,disp,scope,addr,sym,sz) initializer list runs vbank(scope->getArch()) and the body assigns glb = scope->getArch() (funcdata.cc:37/48) then minLanedSize = glb->getMinimumLanedRegisterSize() (cc:49); there is no output parameter, the Architecture reference is stored on the object and every later getArch() consumer (Rule split gates, spacebase resolution, type factory) reads the same pointer.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: No loops in the constructor; the named branch (cc:57-70) attaches one ScopeLocal per construction via glb->symboltab->attachScope(newMap,scope) before funcp.setScope(localmap,baseaddr+-1) and localmap->resetLocalWindow().
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters; minLanedSize is a per-Funcdata field initialized once from the constructor-time glb and reset in clear() from the same glb (funcdata.cc:93).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No ordering decisions; pointer identity (==) is the only comparison, and single-database sharing makes fd2.getArch() == fd.getArch() observable.
